context_clip_fix.description: DrawContext::with_clip now intersects nested clips. Bug: inner clips previously overrode outer clips, allowing content to render outside parent container bounds. Fix: compute rect intersection when pushing onto clip stack. 3 new tests.

layout_bounds_perf_fix.description: layout_bounds() was recursive O(depth²): node at depth D made D*(D+1)/2 taffy.layout() calls. Converted to iterative O(depth) loop over parent chain. Called 2-7 times per element during paint, so this matters for deep trees. Added deeply_nested_layout_absolute_positions test (8 levels, 5px padding each).

div_layout_api.description: Added padding_x/y, padding_top/right/bottom/left, margin, margin_x/y, margin_top/right/bottom/left, min_width/height, max_width/height to Div. Previously only uniform padding(f32). 13 new tests. All methods delegate to taffy Style fields (margin: Rect<LengthPercentageAuto>, min_size/max_size: Size<Dimension>).

quad_builder_api.description: Added Quad builder methods: with_corner_radius(f32), with_corner_radii(Corners<f32>), with_border(color, f32), with_border_widths(color, Edges<f32>). Added DrawContext::paint_rounded_quad and paint_outlined_quad convenience methods. 8 new tests (5 in scene.rs, 3 in context.rs).

drawcontext_line_helpers.description: Added paint_h_line(x, y, length, color, thickness) and paint_v_line(x, y, length, color, thickness) to DrawContext. Both delegate to paint_quad so offset/clip/scale are automatic. 6 new tests: dimensions at 1x scale, offset accumulation, 2x HiDPI scaling for each method.

color_helpers.description: Added color module to motif_core with rgb(), rgba(), gray(), rgb_u8(), rgba_u8(), with_alpha() helpers. All re-exported from crate root. 11 unit tests. Infra build failure: Linux environment missing fontconfig (parley dep); expected to pass on macOS.
